name: Shudder Scythe on the action bar is saved as Murder (#5469)
contract: AscensionCompatData::TalentReplacements (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:63) carries {30, 56, 805708, 500376, {{572382 at 0}}}: in specialization 56, knowing the Shudder Scythe talent 805708 turns Murder 500376 into Shudder Scythe 572382. AscensionClassService::SynchronizeTalentReplacements (AscensionCompat.cpp:884-953), run from OnPlayerLearnSpell (AscensionCompat.cpp:5782-5784), teaches 572382 with learnSpell(572382, true) (AscensionCompat.cpp:945), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it over the active Murder rank with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement (AscensionCompat.cpp:951). Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 572382, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before the class service teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Shudder Scythe must be saved as Murder; a button holding Murder is saved unchanged. With CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.Silent the swap-in and the swap-out of Shudder Scythe print no chat line and the client keeps the replacement after the server drops it.
